MCST and ko.wikipedia end it on 1988-02-24 (MCST prints the day before the successor's start). No report of a new 임명장 around 1993-03-06 was found (News Library and BigKinds searches for 임명장, 문화체육부장관 and 문화체육부장관 임명 1993-03-05..09 return the 3·4 vice-minister ceremony, the 3·6 민자당 당무위원 ceremony and the 3·8 ceremony for three other ministers only), so reappointed_on_reorg is null (not established). The press already used the new title on 3·6 and he presided at the 현판식 on 3·8. Tourism moved in from 교통부 on 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호) without a change of name. Replaced in the 12·23 reshuffle of 1994. The cabinet resigned at a 국무회의 on the afternoon of 23 Dec, the reshuffle was announced at 15:00 and he held his 이임식 at 17:00 that day, so the end is 1994-12-23, as on the MCST page. His successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 24 Dec.

issues.desc: 1988 holdover. 이웅희 (문화공보부, appointed by 전두환) is included with one day in the window. The 5th Republic cabinet tendered its resignations on 1988-02-24 and they were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25, the day 노태우 gave the new ministers their 임명장 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). MCST and ko.wikipedia end his tenure on 1988-02-24. If the project closes all 전두환 spells on 1988-02-24, this spell drops out of the window. The same question applies to every lineage's 1988 holdovers and should be settled once for all of them.

1993 transition. 이수정's end is set to 1993-02-26 (same-day handover, inferred_from_successor). 중앙일보 of 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) says the outgoing cabinet's resignations were all accepted on 25 Feb, and MCST and ko.wikipedia give 1993-02-25. 매일경제 1993-02-24 says the ministers would stay until successors were appointed, and 동아일보, 서울경제, 국민일보 and 조선일보 report farewells and exits of other 노태우 ministers (진념, 이진삼, 최각규, 한봉수) on 26 Feb. The sports (이진삼) and energy (진념) lineages face the same choice and should use the same date.

1993 merger. 이민섭 was announced on 1993-02-26 as 문화체육부장관, but that ministry existed only from 1993-03-06. His spell is split into 문화부장관 1993-02-26..03-05 and 문화체육부장관 from 1993-03-06 (reorg_continuation true, reappointed_on_reorg null). 법률 제4541호 부칙 제2조 excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer, as 법률 제5529호 did in 1998, when the main roster treated the heads of renamed ministries as leaving office. In 1993 he was in office after 3·6 without any reported new 임명장, so this file keeps him in office and leaves the reappointment question open. No 체육청소년부장관 was appointed on 1993-02-26 (동아일보 1993-02-27), so 이민섭 is not recorded in the sports lineage and 체육청소년부 had no minister from 26 Feb to 5 Mar 1993. The industry lineage has the same pattern (김철수, called 상공부장관 in the 대한민국사연표 entry for 1993-03-06).

Start dates use the 임명장 date where the announcement came earlier. The cases are 이웅희 (발령 1986-08-26, 임명장 08-27), 이어령 (announced 1989-12-27 with effect from 1990-01-03), 이수정 (1991-12-19 / 12-20), 주돈식 (1994-12-23 / 12-24), 김영수 (1995-12-20 / 12-21) and 송태호 (1997-03-05 / 03-06). This follows the main roster. The announcement dates are in nominations[]. ko.wikipedia gives 이어령 1989-12-28, the day a 임명장 was trailed in the press, but the ceremony reports found are dated 1990-01-03.

MCST end dates are the day before the successor's start. Where the news shows an exit on the announcement day (이어령 1991-12-19, 이민섭 1994-12-23) the file agrees with MCST. Where the handover was the same day (이웅희 1988-02-25, 정한모 1988-12-05) or no exit was found (주돈식, successor 1995-12-21, and 김영수, successor 1997-03-06) the end is the successor's start, one day after MCST.

Cross-lineage moves. 최병렬 left 문화공보부 on its abolition and became the first 공보처장관 on 1990-01-03 (public_info). 주돈식 moved to 정무장관(제1) on 1995-12-21 (the lineage that holds 정무장관(제1)). Neither of those spells is in this file.

culture.verified.json also holds 오인환's 공보처 spell (1993-02-26..1998-02-27). offices_1988.json assigns 공보처 to the new public_info lineage, so it is not copied here to avoid a duplicate. The only from_main record here is 송태호. No tier 1-3 evidence against it was found (조선일보 1997-03-06 and 서울신문 1997-03-07 agree with its 1997-03-06 start).
No vacancy in the culture lineage between 1986-08-27 and 1998-02-27, so acting[] is empty. Consecutive spells meet either the next day or on the same day (same-day handover).

Gazette files do not exist before 2001, so no spell has tier 1 evidence. Dates rest on the MCST 역대장관 page (tier 2), the 대한민국사연표 and 대통령기록관 schedule (tier 2) and day-of reports from at least two different newspapers (News Library and BigKinds).
